messages:
sam_sales: Quick handoff for Mariner Logistics — signed POC, start date May 15. Main risks: SSO cert still pending, they asked about Dedicated capacity for burst, and integration team wants telemetry hooks. I can walk through contract if needed. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-789
elaine_cs: Thanks — I’ll take onboarding lead. Can someone confirm SSO status and any blockers? I’ll schedule kickoff with customer next Tue. :calendar:
ryan_support: I chatted with their tech lead yesterday — they're on Okta, waiting on the IdP cert from Mariner (they flagged procurement delays). No blocker on our side apart from needing the cert and an SP metadata exchange. :thinking_face:
mira_eng: Re: telemetry hooks — we can expose the minimal event stream. Need eng ticket to scope bandwidth and retention. Is this for monitoring only or for billing/usage?
sam_sales: It's primarily for health metrics + SLA traces (latency spikes). They also want request-level trace ids for support handoffs. Renewal risk if onboarding slips >3 weeks.
elaine_cs: Ok — owners: SSO owner = sam_sales to keep chasing cert, CS owner = elaine_cs, Eng owner = mira_eng for telemetry, Support owner = ryan_support for connector testing. I'll create a shared runbook.
mira_eng: Creating ENG ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1234. Add specifics there (retention 7d, 1k req/s bursts).
ryan_support: I'll spin up a test account and exercise the connector once SSO is in place. ETA for connector smoke tests: 48h after cert received.
sam_sales: Note on Dedicated: sales pre-approved a small reserved pool (2x A10s) for pilot bursts. Need infra provisioning and cost signoff. I pushed approval to procurement last week.
elaine_cs: Can infra provision in a sandbox region? We want to avoid production until we validate. Also need runbook steps for fallback to hosted API if capacity hits limits.
mira_eng: Sandbox provisioning command (example):
```
infra-provision --org mariner --env sandbox --tier dedicated --gpus 2 --duration 30d
```
I'll add the exact CLI to ENG-1234.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Dedicated capacity quota request queued. ETA 72 hours. (req-5643)
ryan_support: Quick note: there's an existing bug with SAML redirect on older Okta tenants. I'll attach logs to CS-789 once I reproduce.
elaine_cs: Action items (owners):
- chase IdP cert (sam_sales)
- schedule kickoff + share runbook draft (elaine_cs)
- scope telemetry + implement minimal stream (mira_eng, ENG-1234)
- provision sandbox dedicated pool (infra via ENG-1234 / oncall-bot)
- connector smoke tests after SSO (ryan_support)
- customer success playbook + renewal checkpoint at week 3 (elaine_cs)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you’ve accepted the item you own.
sam_sales: Accepted and will ping procurement daily until cert is in. :thumbsup:
mira_eng: Accepted, will update ENG-1234 with schema. :thumbsup:
ryan_support: Accepted, will schedule smoke tests and attach logs. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Provision request req-5643 moved to in-progress. Estimated completion 2026-05-01 14:00 UTC.
elaine_cs: Thanks team — I'll drop the kickoff invite and attach the runbook + CS checklist to CS-789. If any blocker hits, escalate in this thread and tag @mira_eng or @ryan_support for immediate triage.
sam_sales: One more customer ask — they'd like a monthly usage export to their S3. Not high priority for pilot, but flagging for roadmap.
mira_eng: Noted — add as feature request to ENG-1234 with priority "post-pilot".
elaine_cs: Closing notes: next sync in 5 days or when cert arrives. I'll update first_message_ts/last_message_ts in the thread metadata once kickoff is confirmed.
